segments.ja378:1.1: Paṅko ca kāmā palipo ca kāmā, bhayañca metaṃ timūlaṃ pavuttaṃ;
segments.ja378:1.3: Rajo ca dhūmo ca mayā pakāsitā, hitvā tuvaṃ pabbaja brahmadatta.
segments.ja378:2.1: Gadhito [gathito (sī.)] ca ratto ca adhimucchito ca, kāmesvahaṃ brāhmaṇa bhiṃsarūpaṃ;
segments.ja378:2.3: Taṃ nussahe jīvikattho pahātuṃ, kāhāmi puññāni anappakāni.
segments.ja378:3.1: Yo atthakāmassa hitānukampino, ovajjamāno na karoti sāsanaṃ;
segments.ja378:3.3: Idameva seyyo iti maññamāno, punappunaṃ gabbhamupeti mando.
segments.ja378:4.1: So ghorarūpaṃ nirayaṃ upeti, subhāsubhaṃ muttakarīsapūraṃ;
segments.ja378:4.3: Sattā sakāye na jahanti giddhā, ye honti kāmesu avītarāgā.
segments.ja378:5.1: Mīḷhena littā ruhirena makkhitā, semhena littā upanikkhamanti;
segments.ja378:5.3: Yaṃ yañhi kāyena phusanti tāvade, sabbaṃ asātaṃ dukhameva kevalaṃ.
segments.ja378:6.1: Disvā vadāmi na hi aññato savaṃ, pubbenivāsaṃ bahukaṃ sarāmi;
segments.ja378:6.3: Citrāhi gāthāhi subhāsitāhi, darīmukho nijjhāpayi sumedhanti.
